documents.title: Conservation report
documents.text:
Conservation report: Sunder Roll (fictional, authored test material).
Sunder Roll had share of palimpsest leaves of 31.1% in FY2025, first issue. For Sunder Roll, leaf height in FY2024 was 236 mm. Illuminated initials at Sunder Roll stood at 34 with effect from 1 Jul 2025. Sunder Roll had insured value of $13m in FY2024 (reported basis). The meaning of the rubric "de gradibus" for Sunder Roll is understood as follows: a reference to the gradual psalms.

documents.title: Palaeographic study
documents.text:
Palaeographic study: Sunder Roll (fictional, authored test material).
Sunder Roll had marginal annotations of 474 in FY2024. For Sunder GmbH, binding date (CE) in FY2024 was 1418. Leaf height at Sunder Roll stood at roughly 230 mm in FY2024. Sunder Roll had illuminated initials of 27 with effect from 1 Jan 2025.

documents.title: Edition apparatus notes
documents.text:
Edition apparatus notes: Sunder Roll (fictional, authored test material).
Sunder Roll had share of palimpsest leaves of 38% in FY2025, second issue (corrects the first issue). For Sunder Nordic, a subsidiary, marginal annotations in FY2024 was 579. Binding date (CE) at Sunder Oy stood at 1621 in FY2024. Sunder Roll had insured value of $10.1m in FY2024 (reported basis). The meaning of the rubric "de gradibus" for Sunder Roll is understood as follows: a reference to ranks of the clergy.
